Vayne

Jungle Sleeper

Jungle Vayne

How to play this build

In the jungle, Tumble (Q) repositions and Condemn (E) into a wall stuns on ganks; the ult grants invisibility for surprise dives. Your W's True Damage melts tanks: land three hits on the same target.

Skill order

Max priority:

W Virotes de Plata → Q Voltereta → E Condenar

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
Silver Bolts (W) for true damage that melts tanks; Tumble (Q) second for repositioning. E (stun) at 1 point.

Items and what they do

  1. Spirit of the Ancient Golem Tank jungle item: health, tenacity and the Smite buff (jungle sustain).
  2. Blade of the Ruined King % max-health on-hit and lifesteal; active steals move speed. Melts tanks.
  3. Statikk Shiv Attack speed, crit and move speed; charges up and zaps several enemies in a chain.
  4. Berserker's Greaves Boots granting attack speed.
  5. Frozen Mallet Lots of health and some AD; your auto-attacks slow the target (permaslow).

Masteries: how they work

In Season 3 you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
21/9/0 — Offense
Why this page
21/9/0 gives damage with durability to gank and duel in the jungle.
